server.name: Task Queue — Server
server.description: Manages the worker lifecycle — start, stop, or check status.

worker.name: Task Queue — Worker
worker.description: Long-running HTTP + WebSocket server. Accepts job submissions, simulates work, and streams logs.

client.name: Task Queue — Client
client.description: Submits jobs via HTTP, streams per-job logs via WebSocket, and prints a completion report.
